bugs.title: Shadow Clone creation stalls forever on 'Preparing repository…'
bugs.notes: Seeded 2026-08-28. Live user-facing failure: progress message stuck at first indeterminate stage, no success/error ever shown; /start works afterwards (flow died silently). Prior sweep (bug-47/48) claimed a fix + live verification but symptom persists post-sweep, and bug-63 apparently moved the copy to a dispatched Actions workflow with polling of .clipforge-clone-status.json — investigate from current code: (1) can createPrivateShadowClone reject unhandled / escape try-catch in handleClonePatMessage (onProgress throw, Promise.all rejection, Worker kill on CPU/wall-clock limit); (2) is the whole op exceeding Workers request duration (600+ sequential API calls at chunk 4) — if so, structural redesign to workflow_dispatch relay pattern (check whether bug-63 already did this and where the stall actually is, e.g. polling loop never resolving); (3) can renderInteractiveView/onProgress edit calls throw 429 uncaught. Regardless of root cause: every clone attempt must end in success OR a clear error message — never silent stall. Verify end-to-end vs live GitHub API with realistic-size repo.

bugs.title: Shadow Clones should relay through central Bot A/Bot B, not need their own
bugs.notes: Seeded 2026-08-28. Architecture change. Clones currently lack the direct-video Telegram relay (INTERNAL_RELAY_GROUP_CHAT_ID/RELAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY exist only on central Worker; isOriginalRepo gates in bot/src/index.js). Goal: a clone hands the relay step off to central Bot A/Bot B via an authenticated, per-clone-scoped API/webhook/dispatch — central secrets must NOT be copied to clones. Must preserve sealed-payload security model (bot/src/relay.js; tests: sealed-payload, relay caption, rememberCopiedMedia) multi-tenant: Bot B only acts on payloads matching a job it was told to expect. Audit all 7 isOriginalRepo call sites; touch only relay-related gating. Extend test/*.mjs relay suite. Document design in code comments like the rest of the codebase. Do not rush.

bugs.title: Clone Deploy Bots fails: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN never provisioned
bugs.notes: Seeded 2026-08-28. Real Actions log on fresh clone (clipforge-clone-zuaua5): wrangler deploy fails for missing CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; bug-68 failure-alert step then ALSO fails (exit 1) because BOTB_MTPROTO_BOT_TOKEN absent. Fix: (a) bot/setup flow must tell user exactly which secrets to add and where (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions), matching bug-53 docs; (b) consider optional Cloudflare-token collection in create-clone flow with setActionsSecret provisioning (check whether ANY secret provisioning already happens in createPrivateShadowClone) — documented manual step is acceptable if auto-provisioning is a large scope increase; (c) verify announceDeployFailure polling (bot/src/commands/start.js) works cross-repo for clones; (d) make the intentional-failure alert step clearer in Actions UI (e.g. ::error:: annotation) so a red X is distinguishable from a broken alert.
